steps.scene: Ahead is a round sign with a bold red ring around the edge. You can't make out the symbol inside yet.

question.prompt: What is the round shape with a red ring already telling you?

options.text: There is something you must NOT do ahead
There is a hazard ahead to watch for
It is giving directions to a place

question.explanation: Circles give orders. A red ring means a prohibition — something you must not do. The symbol shows what.

steps.title: No entry
steps.body: A red circle with a white horizontal bar means no entry — you must not drive past it. It often marks the exit of a one-way street.

question.prompt: A red circle with a single white horizontal bar means…

options.text: No through road
No entry for vehicles
Give way ahead

question.explanation: The red circle with a white bar is 'no entry'. A no-through-road sign is a different, rectangular sign.

a.label: White bar
a.body: A red circle with one white bar: no entry — no vehicles may pass at all.

b.label: Car + bike
b.body: A red circle showing a car and motorbike: no motor vehicles (cycles may still pass).

question.prompt: A red circle shows a black car and motorbike. It means…

options.text: No entry for anyone, the same as the white-bar sign
No motor vehicles — cycles and pedestrians may still pass
Cars must turn around here

question.explanation: It bans motor vehicles, not all traffic. The white-bar 'no entry' sign bans all vehicles.

steps.title: No overtaking
steps.body: A red circle with a red car beside a black car means no overtaking. You must not overtake until you pass the sign that ends it.

question.prompt: A red circle shows two cars side by side, one red. It means…

options.text: Overtaking is discouraged but allowed if clear
You must not overtake
Two-way traffic ahead

question.explanation: It is an order, not advice: no overtaking until the end sign. Two-way traffic is a warning triangle, not a red circle.

question.prompt: A red ring around the number 30 means…

options.text: Maximum 30 mph — you must not exceed it
Aim to drive at least 30 mph
The recommended speed is 30 mph

question.explanation: A red ring around a number is a compulsory maximum speed limit — never a minimum or a suggestion.

steps.scene: You reach a narrow bridge. A sign shows a large black arrow pointing up and a smaller red arrow pointing down. A car is coming the other way.

question.prompt: What does the sign tell you to do?

options.text: You have priority — carry on across
Give way to the oncoming traffic
Both directions must stop and wait

question.explanation: The larger black arrow is the oncoming traffic with priority; the small red arrow is you — wait. The reverse sign gives you priority.

steps.wrongBelief: A solid blue circle is just advice or information you can ignore.

options.text: It isn't — only red signs are orders
Blue circles give positive orders you must follow, like 'turn left'
Blue circles always mean parking

question.explanation: Circles give orders. Red-ringed circles say what you must not do; solid blue circles say what you must do.

steps.repairNote: A blue circle is a positive instruction you must obey (turn left, mini-roundabout). It is an order, not a hint.
